messages:
Samira G: Quick heads-up — CobaltMetrics onboarding shows 95th pct latency ~1.6s on their /generate route and token cost is spiking vs forecast. They hit the PLG usage threshold, account flagged for NRR review if we don't cut cost or latency in 2 weeks.

Jules M: thanks, digging into traces now. Do we have per-route token distribution? could be long-context churn + cold cache.

Samira G: yes — most requests are 512-1024 tokens, lots of repeated prefixes (chat assistant). KV cache hit rate is ~18%. Batching currently off in their Dedicated pool for latency concerns.

Ravi P: flagging renewal risk. Cobalt said procurement will review if we can't promise <1s p95 or 20% cost reduction. Can we propose a quick win plan?

Jules M: Proposal (short): 1) Canary model swap to rw-fast-7b-q4 for non-critical users (30% traffic) 2) Enable per-route prefix KV caching + small warmup to raise hit rate 3) Apply int8 quant profile on model for Dedicated pool 4) Routing policy: latency-first for mobile clients, cost-first for batch endpoints.

Nadia L: +1. Also suggest enabling continuous batching with max_wait 5ms and target batch_size 16 for that pool. Shouldn't add much latency and will cut cost.

Samira G: Can we draft the rollout plan to share with the customer and Solutions? They want concrete numbers.

Jules M: Draft numbers from local sim: int8 qswap -> ~30% GPU token cost reduction, p95 latency on rw-fast-7b-q4 -> ~0.8-0.95s with batching and warm cache, KV cache improvement to 60% hit -> another ~15% cost drop. Combined ~40% cost cut, p95 target hit. Will validate on canary.

Ravi P: sounds good. Need guardrails for quality regressions — add eval set from their shared prompts and automatic rollback if BLEU/EM/metric drops >3% (or replace with model fallback).

Jules M: added config snippet for the canary (paste):

```yaml
route: /generate
policy:
  canary: 0.3
  fallback: rw-main-13b
  routing_priority: [latency, cost]
quantization:
  profile: int8
  model_override: rw-fast-7b-q4
batching:
  enabled: true
  max_wait_ms: 5
  target_batch: 16
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  warmup: true
  target_hit: 0.6
quality_checks:
  eval_set: cobalt_onboard_v1
  rollback_threshold_pct: 3
```

Samira G: perfect. I'll schedule a 30-min enablement call with Cobalt this week and share the canary timeline. @ops-bot can you provision a canary pool with the int8 profile for Dedicated region us-west-2?

ops-bot: acknowledged — provisioning canary pool (dedicated-us-west-2) with int8 profile. ETA ~20m. Deployment will post updates. :gear:

Nadia L: I'll own the eval harness and run the regression tests after first 1k canary responses.

Ravi P: I'll update renewal risk doc and set expectation with account exec. Samira — share customer-facing note after enablement call.

Samira G: thanks team. We'll aim to present before their procurement review in 10 days.

Jules M: one more note — if latency still >1s on mobile after canary, swap routing: mobile -> rw-lowlat-3b, desktop -> rw-fast-7b-q4. That should keep quality and shave p95 further.

Samira G: noted. Closing loop once canary results are in. :thumbsup:
